purpose: Register the executable 2M counterfactual pre-read router screen before any GPU run: the paired-rollout spec, the supervision sources, the prompt split, the four arms and the attribution control, the win bar and the next route. The S50 registration corrected the router's ordering and its outcome label; this file registers the run that tests them.

amends.rule: the S50 file is not edited. This registration consumes its corrected interfaces unchanged and adds the runner, the prompt set and the decision rule.

status: runner and CPU contract implemented and tested; the 2M screen is registered and NOT run. It may run only after the corrected 20M bar has a receipt and the real-gradient first-moment validation has settled the storage (S50 queue items (a)-(d)).

prompt_set.split_unit: prompt_id; the loader also refuses the same normalised question text in two splits
prompt_set.source: openai/gsm8k train, first 64 rows by sha256(question) ascending, graded 48/8/8
prompt_set.why_gsm8k_train: the anchored harness scores the GSM8K test split and MATH-500; using GSM8K train keeps the router calibration disjoint from both. The prompt set is committed so the split, the answers and the sampling are fixed before the run.
prompt_set.no_leakage: a prompt id and a normalised prompt text each appear in exactly one split; labels_from_records independently rejects a label key in features and a prompt in both fit and holdout

sampling.greedy_rule: temperature 0.0 and top_p 1.0; K repeats are real decodes and must be identical, which is the determinism check
sampling.pairing: base and memory draws share (prompt_id, sample_index) and the same stable seed; they do not share any other seed
sampling.verification: each completion is verified separately with frontier.rft.verify (exact numeric or canonical expression); ambiguous and unparseable are failures, reported as their own verdicts
sampling.primary_label: Delta_outcome = P(correct|memory) - P(correct|base) over the K pairs
sampling.secondary_label: Delta_CE = CE_base - CE_memory on the completion; per-token CE differences are recorded for audit, not used as prompt-token targets

memory_condition.role: the 2M-token memory arm is the base+memory side of the paired rollouts
memory_condition.mechanism: conv-free 8-row table gather with the registered memory key gate and value projection, no cross-token convolution
memory_condition.why_conv_free: the corrective memory's 8-channel causal convolution needs the retrieved values of the preceding kernel-1 tokens. A routed token may have unselected predecessors whose rows were never fetched, so that convolution cannot be evaluated exactly from a sparse gather. The routed mechanism therefore removes the convolution and the paired memory side is the same conv-free operator with every token selected. This is a registered mechanism, not a lossy approximation of the corrective arm.

allow_list: h_t (causal hidden state at the site)
features.implied_by_api: oracle/frontier/utility_routing.py:PreReadUtilityRouter.features enforces the list; metadata must be exactly {position_fraction, budget_fraction} in [0,1]
features.why: the decision must be computable before the memory fetch. A feature from the read, or from any label, makes the route either post-fetch or supervised leakage.

targets_and_cost.absolute_control_source: verified-outcome is kept as a registered source and is not the outcome route
targets_and_cost.cost: physical_read_accounting: unique rows requested, bytes by tier and cache state; the read-magnitude surrogate measured_cost(read) is never used
targets_and_cost.cost_units: the screen reports rows and bytes per token and sweeps the gate threshold; it does not invent a nats-per-byte price
targets_and_cost.row_unit: one store request is the 8 addressed table rows for one token; the table is fp32, so 8 * 256 * 4 = 8192 bytes per request

training.router: PreReadUtilityRouter, zero-initialised output layer, seeded first layer
training.data: fit split trains, calibration split chooses the epoch, holdout is scored once
training.loss: weighted mean squared error on Delta; weight 1/T per prompt so prompts weigh equally regardless of length
training.determinism: same seed, data and torch build reproduce the parameter hash; asserted by the test suite
training.refusal: no rollouts, no hidden-state artifact or a prompt without a verified pair refuses training

utility-ce.role: the CE route; asks whether outcome labels are needed

no-memory-gate.read: zero read at every selected token
no-memory-gate.role: gate-only control: any accuracy change cannot come from memory content; parity with base is the expected outcome

matched-dense.checkpoint: results/stage2/runs/gated-dense-2m-math/ckpt-000976.pt is the gate-attribution control; the matched dense adapter is the data control
matched-dense.role: equal active union without the external memory

gated-dense.role: attribution control: the same zero-initialised gate over a dense read; a routed win must also beat this arm

evaluation.split: holdout prompts only; no prompt in fit or calib
evaluation.accuracy: exact-answer accuracy over K samples per prompt, all-items denominator; ambiguous and unparseable count as failures and are reported separately
evaluation.read_measurement: the measured gather ledger (requests, unique table rows, bytes) plus physical_read_accounting for the prompt-token selection audit
evaluation.mask_enforcement: the runtime audit requires exactly zero contribution outside the mask; the store is called with exactly the selected indices
evaluation.gate_statistics: mean/min/max of the pre-read gate and the predicted Delta on holdout prompt tokens

win_bar.rule: an arm wins the screen only if (1) its holdout exact-answer accuracy beats the base by more than the combined binomial standard error, (2) it beats the matched gated-dense control by more than the combined binomial standard error, and (3) it requests fewer measured read bytes than the dense control
win_bar.why_both_controls: beating base alone can be the dense data control's gain; beating the gate control alone can be the gate rather than the route. The route claim needs both and a measured read saving.
win_bar.null_result: if neither utility arm wins, the pre-read routing hypothesis is not supported at 2M and no 20M router arm is registered
win_bar.no_single_number_win: no accuracy or byte number may be quoted from the training log; every number comes from the eval receipt

decision_rule: 1. utility-outcome wins: carry the pre-read outcome router to the 20M routed-memory bar beside the corrective arm at equal active union.
2. utility-ce wins and utility-outcome does not: register a threshold/cost sweep, then a 20M CE-supervised router; outcome supervision is not adopted.
3. no utility arm wins: the pre-read routing hypothesis is a null at 2M; register no 20M router arm and report the post-read gate comparison instead.
4. no-memory-gate differs from base beyond its standard error: the screen is invalid (the gate-only control must be the identity); report and do not select an arm.
5. the mask audit fails: the screen is invalid regardless of accuracy; no arm is selected.

next_route.if_outcome_wins: 20M routed-memory bar with the pre-read outcome router, scored beside the corrective arm and the matched gated-dense control on the anchored harness
next_route.if_ce_wins: threshold/cost sweep, then the 20M CE-supervised router
next_route.if_null: no 20M router arm; the next route is the post-read gate comparison already registered at S43
next_route.never: a 20M router arm is never registered from a 2M null, a mean CE improvement, or a read-magnitude saving

queue_order.gate_1: the corrected 20M bar has a receipt
queue_order.gate_2: the real-gradient first-moment validation receipt exists; if it requires the bf16 switch the screen runs with --first-moment bfloat16
queue_order.gate_3: the rollout and eval stages refuse to start before both; the screen must follow (a)-(d), not run in parallel
queue_order.memory_sizing: the screen's limit is derived from its own smoke peak; a bf16 first moment leaves 0.16 GiB of the 12.5 GiB VRAM limit and the router adds parameters

test_claims: prompt-set split leakage and sampling drift refuse
Delta_outcome sign is correct on hand-built paired rollouts and each side is verified separately
greedy K repeats are identical; a non-deterministic greedy generator refuses
the feature allow-list rejects post-read and label keys
training is deterministic and chooses the calibration epoch
unselected tokens receive exactly zero contribution and zero store requests
physical accounting counts unique rows and tier bytes; the cost term refuses the surrogate
missing or unpaired rollouts refuse the runner
the win bar needs both controls and fewer bytes

what_this_registration_does_not_establis: that the pre-read router improves routing: no screen has run
that the paired outcome label beats the absolute control: that is the registered experiment
that the conv-free routed read matches the corrective arm's read: it is a registered mechanism with its own dense condition, not an approximation
that the 2M result transfers to 20M or to the anchored harness
that the cost units are a price: the screen reports bytes and sweeps the threshold
